# daemon

> Pure-Go on-demand process lifecycle and local IPC layer for shared background services used by CLI tools and agents. Zero CGO, zero dependencies.

Module: github.com/grpmsoft/daemon
Go: 1.27+
License: MIT
Organization: grpmsoft (github.com/grpmsoft)

## Overview

Your CLI starts a background process when needed, shares it between multiple clients, and shuts it down when idle. The owner of the process lifetime is demand, not an init system.

Not a system service manager. For systemd/launchd/SCM use kardianos/service. The two are complementary. Do not mix Restart=always with idle auto-shutdown.

Three modes: Client (Start/Stop/Restart/EnsureRunning/Hold/Release/Status), Server (Serve -- foreground daemon with HTTP, PID, signals, lease, token), Proxy (stdin/stdout <-> HTTP bridge for MCP/JSON-RPC).

## Core Abstraction

EnsureRunning -- start if needed, return port if already running. Race-safe: two agents calling simultaneously never produce two daemons. Serialized on kernel-level file lock + in-process mutex.

EnsureRunning check order: (1) IsHeld -> return existing daemon, (2) stop-intent -> ErrStopIntent, (3) cooldown -> ErrSpawnCooldown, (4) startLocked.

Lease-based connection tracking: TCP connection lifetime IS the lease. Client crash -> kernel closes socket -> count drops -> idle shutdown proceeds. No heartbeats, no timers, no stray counts from crashed clients.

Hold/Release: Hold(ctx) stops daemon + writes .stop-intent marker. EnsureRunning returns ErrStopIntent while held. Release(), Start(), Restart() clear the marker.

Spawn cooldown: after spawn failure, EnsureRunning returns ErrSpawnCooldown for SpawnCooldown duration (default 5s). Prevents rapid respawn loops.

## API

### Config

- Name (string, required) -- application name
- DataDir (string, required) -- runtime files directory, resolved to absolute
- Binary (string, default os.Executable()) -- daemon executable
- Args ([]string) -- arguments for child process
- Dir (string, default DataDir) -- child working directory
- Timeout (time.Duration, default 30s) -- health check wait
- HealthPath (string, default "/health")
- IdleTimeout (time.Duration, 0=disabled) -- auto-shutdown
- DisableTokenAuth (bool, default false) -- skip bearer auth for app handler
- SpawnCooldown (time.Duration, default 5s, -1=disabled) -- cooldown after spawn failure
- ShutdownTimeout (time.Duration, default 10s) -- total graceful shutdown budget

### Daemon Methods (all return *Info except Stop, Hold, Release)

- Start(ctx) (*Info, error) -- error if already running; clears stop-intent
- EnsureRunning(ctx) (*Info, error) -- idempotent; respects stop-intent and cooldown
- Stop(ctx) error -- graceful: HTTP shutdown -> force kill; does NOT block restarts
- Hold(ctx) error -- stop + write .stop-intent marker (blocks EnsureRunning)
- Release() -- clear .stop-intent marker (no lock needed)
- Restart(ctx) (*Info, error) -- stop + start, single lock; clears stop-intent
- Status() (*Info, error) -- read-only, no lock
- IsRunning() bool -- read-only, no lock

Config immutable after New(). Concurrent calls safe (sync.Mutex + file lock).

### Package Functions

- New(Config) *Daemon -- create with defaults
- NewWithDeps(Config, PIDStore, ProcessManager, HealthChecker) *Daemon -- test injection
- EnsureRunning(ctx, Config) (int, error) -- convenience wrapper
- Serve(ctx, Config, http.Handler) error -- server mode
- Proxy(ctx, Config, ProxyOptions) error -- stdin/stdout bridge

### Interfaces

- PIDStore -- Save, Load, Clear, IsAlive, Path
- ProcessManager -- Start(ctx, StartSpec), KillProcess(ctx, pid, grace), IsProcessAlive
- HealthChecker -- Check(port, healthPath), WaitUntilReady(ctx, port, healthPath, timeout)

### StartSpec

- Binary (string) -- executable path
- Args ([]string) -- command-line arguments
- Dir (string) -- working directory
- Env ([]string) -- environment variables
- LogFile (string) -- stderr/stdout log file path
- ExtraFiles ([]*os.File) -- additional file descriptors (e.g., PID lock fd)

### Sentinel Errors

- ErrNotRunning -- daemon not running
- ErrAlreadyRunning -- already running
- ErrStartTimeout -- health check timeout
- ErrUnhealthy -- health check failed
- ErrStalePIDFile -- PID file exists, process dead
- ErrInvalidConfig -- invalid configuration
- ErrStopIntent -- held via Hold(); EnsureRunning refuses auto-start
- ErrSpawnCooldown -- spawn cooldown active after recent failure

### Security

Bearer token (crypto/rand) in PID file (0600). /daemon/* requires Authorization: Bearer. App handler requires token by default (DisableTokenAuth=false). /health open. DNS rebinding: loopbackGuard + token.

Endpoints:

| Method | Path | Auth | Purpose |
|--------|------|------|---------|
| GET | /health | None | Readiness probe |
| GET | /daemon/attach | Bearer | Lease connection |
| POST | /daemon/shutdown | Bearer | Graceful stop |

## File Structure

```
daemon.go        -- Daemon, Start/Stop/Restart/EnsureRunning/Status/Hold/Release,
                   acquireStartupLock/startLocked/stopLocked/buildInfo,
                   Serve, ConnTracker, /daemon/attach, authGuard, loopbackGuard,
                   stop-intent and spawn-cooldown marker helpers
config.go        -- Config, Status, Info, PIDInfo, StartSpec, interfaces
group.go         -- Group (oklog/run actor pattern, zero deps)
proxy.go         -- Proxy, proxyAttach (lease), IsHeld pre-check
ensure.go        -- EnsureRunning (package wrapper), waitForPort
defaults.go      -- Default implementations
errors.go        -- Sentinel errors
internal/
  pidlock/       -- Cross-platform lock (flock/share-mode)
  pidfile.go     -- PID file JSON persistence
  process_*.go   -- Platform-specific process management
  health.go      -- HTTP health polling
  lock_*.go      -- ctx-aware startup lock
```
